canonical_name: LU decomposition theorem family with unresolved pivot and hypothesis boundary
literal_source_claim_zh: 矩阵可分解为下三角与上三角矩阵之积
literal_source_claim_en: A matrix can be decomposed as a product of a lower-triangular and an upper-triangular matrix.
statement_blocker: The catalog supplies no matrix domain, scalar class, shape, pivot or permutation convention, hypotheses, diagonal normalization, uniqueness clause, or boundary cases. Its universal unpivoted reading is refuted over the rationals by the 2 x 2 swap matrix. Adding a permutation or nonzero-pivot hypotheses would change the proposition, so selecting a corrected root at intake would invent or substitute mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Open: an approved source must fix square or rectangular matrices, ordered finite index types, scalar field or ring, universe levels, pivot conditions, and any rank or invertibility hypotheses.
conclusion: Open: a source-corrected existence statement for lower and upper triangular factors, possibly with a permutation and/or pivot hypotheses; exact equation, witness types, normalization, and uniqueness are unresolved.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a corrected proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve every case listed in scope-map.md.
